description: Defines the VisitType entity class which represents different types of visits (e.g., 'Initial HIV Clinic Visit') in the OpenMRS medical record system. Includes fields, constructors, and methods for managing visit type data.

classes.name: VisitType
classes.description: Entity class representing a type of visit in the system, with properties like visitTypeId, name, and description, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

methods.name: getVisitTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the visit type.

methods.name: setVisitTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the visit type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the method to retrieve the unique identifier for this entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the unique identifier for this entity.

methods.name: VisitType
methods.description: Constructors for creating instances of VisitType; includes default, with ID, and with name/description.
